endorsements.name: Sol Roberts
endorsements.label: Purple Teaming! But It’s with Your DevOps Team
endorsements.description: We’re all familiar with purple teaming to improve collaboration and security posture across organizations’ red and blue teams, but what about involving the DevOps team? In this talk, we’ll investigate how to develop and improve collaboration between your security teams and DevOps teams to strengthen cross-departmental relationships and ensure better security from start to finish.
